author: Forbes
description:
Billionaire Joe Lonsdale’s venture capital firm 8VC has invested in an animal testing startup founded by the former chief operating officer of a company that incurred the largest ever fine in the U.S. for violating the Animal Welfare Act.

Safer Human Medicine, founded in 2023 by animal testing veteran Jim Harkness, is aiming to breed some 30,000 monkeys that will be used in medical research. The firm has raised $28 million to date, of which Lonsdale’s 8VC invested $20 million in 2023, according to multiple sources familiar with the deal.

While 8VC doesn’t list SHM among its portfolio companies on its website, Lonsdale revealed that he’d invested in the company on Jack Altman’s podcast in May. “Would you rather save your sibling or the monkey?” Lonsdale asked in the podcast while talking about SHM’s work. “It’s not evil… it’s pro-human.” Last Thursday, 8VC wrote about the company for the first time on its X account—to which Lonsdale responded with a monkey and U.S. flag emoji.

title: Why This Palantir Billionaire Is Backing A Plan To Breed 30,000 Monkeys
